## Result and scope

Agent #114's short-spacer contribution now includes the exact independently verified endpoint-normalization repair. Under the unchanged canonical digit and pair-word hypotheses, the six endpoints give the common first reverse-add value, time-zero nonpalindromicity for `r=1,2,3,4`, and nonpalindromicity at each positive time 1 through 11 for those four parameters.

The original four 3,000-step trajectories and the r=5 time-eleven positive control remain exact finite computations. This PR makes no later first-hit, infinite-time, or seed-196 claim.

## Repair and preservation

Agent #31 is the delivery owner under [the existing coordination task](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/p196/coordination/proofs/coordination/tasks/agent31-session02893e4f368d-pr104-delivery-20261016.json). Agent #114 remains the source author; Agent #1 authored the reviewed proof repair.

- Repair adoption: `945fb3337513d52c52df09cc6b11bde62841a7eb`.
- Registry/evidence publication: `c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1`.
- Repaired root Git blob: `b7ee9c4d16e8477439d343ac18483462599ebf6c`.
- All six theorem statements, imports, options, historical comments and the other five proofs are unchanged.
- Original failed source, original report and original PR description are preserved under `integration/original/`. Original failure remains FAIL; historical labels describe the original author session.
- All 21 changed paths are additive under this contribution directory relative to the inspected main comparison. No existing main source or verifier is modified.

## Verification

| Obligation | Actual evidence |
|---|---|
| Repaired seven-module Lean closure | Existing independent fresh execution reused; every module and the separate complete audit passed with `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false` |
| Logical dependencies | 1,523 theorem constants and 171 safe definitions; only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; six public type/axiom reports |
| Exact source and runtime binding | Independent Agent #31 evidence specialist checked all source pins, runner, full raw logs, original failure and trusted Lean 4.19.0 runtime identity |
| Actual build inclusion | [Scoped registry](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-114/short-r-firsthit-20261016/integration/BUILD_REGISTRY.json) for the unchanged canonical verifier; seven sources, one root, six endpoints |
| New registry verification | Actual `--check-only` exited zero; source/import verification only, `mathematical_proof_check=false`; separate independent wiring review passed |
| Finite controls | Agent #31 reran both original Python scripts; generator output is byte-identical and all four 3,000-step traces plus r=5 control passed |
| New Lean execution by Agent #31 | **NOT_RUN**; qualifying exact-source independent evidence is reused |
| Preservation | All 133 substantive evidence files retained in a roundtrip-verified lossless archive with per-file identities and recovery instructions |

The canonical verifier's optional full mode does not add explicit `--trust=0` or reproduce the independent safe-definition audit; [reproduction instructions](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-114/short-r-firsthit-20261016/integration/REPRODUCE.md) state the exact supported commands and limits.

## Review and complete evidence

- [Original independent repair review 5554297272](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/pull/104#pullrequestreview-5554297272), evidence commit `36f3a58b22c93bef9f6fbc234d9bab8b5ebd43d0`.
- [Complete retained-evidence validation](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-114/short-r-firsthit-20261016/integration/reviews/RETAINED_EVIDENCE_REVIEW.md).
- [Independent new-wiring review](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-114/short-r-firsthit-20261016/integration/reviews/WIRING_REVIEW.md).
- [All evidence and recovery manifest](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-114/short-r-firsthit-20261016/integration/evidence/pr104-package.json).
- [Current report and preserved original report](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/c9a86a40ffd478f7c01ac68688896cba91f94dd1/proofs/contributions/agent-114/short-r-firsthit-20261016/REPORT.md).

The exact final head, target combination, actual platform state, serialized ordinary merge and post-merge checks are recorded by Agent #31 in the coordination task. Separate nonauthor review is evidenced by the actual specialists and retained execution; no different GitHub account or unperformed build is implied.
